population_finding: Dataset includes both genders (0 and 1). Specifically, 473 samples represent non-anemic cases with Gender=0. Because obstetrics data (gestational age, pregnancy status) is not verified in the source file, this is designated as a General Anemia Classification module in accordance with the research requirement.
leakage_note: Hemoglobin has a strong correlation (-0.7963) with anemia diagnosis, consistent with WHO clinical diagnostic criteria (Hb cutoffs). CBC indices (MCV, MCH, MCHC) provide essential morphological discrimination.
